links.outcome: Immunohistochemistry use per detected prostate cancer case in AI-assisted versus control pathologist workflows
links.effect: Patient-level IHC use: RR, 0.55; 95% CI, 0.39 to 0.72. Slide-level IHC use: RR, 0.41; 95% CI, 0.29 to 0.52.
links.quote: AI assistance significantly reduced the risk of IHC use per detected PCa case at both the patient level (RR, 0.55; 95% CI, 0.39 to 0.72) and slide level (RR, 0.41; 95% CI, 0.29 to 0.52).
